data.one_liner: Dynamically switch between multiple themes and persist selection across restarts.
data.what_it_does: It lets you define a collection of ThemeData objects, choose one at runtime, and automatically saves the chosen theme ID using shared_preferences. The selected theme is restored when the app restarts.
use_when: You need a user-selectable theme system that survives app restarts
You want a simple, widget-based API without extra state management
avoid_when: You already use a complex state management solution that handles theme persistence
You need advanced theming features like dynamic color schemes or platform adaptive theming
strengths: Easy to set up with a single widget
weaknesses: Relies on shared_preferences, so limited to key-value storage
No support for dynamic color schemes or system theme sync
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, wrap MaterialApp with DynamicTheme, provide ThemeCollection and optional defaultThemeId
